body: Folder-scoped Claude conversation lookups go through claude.HistoryDir(home, dir) / claude.EncodePath (<home>/projects/<every non-[A-Za-z0-9] byte -> '-'>) and report the queried dir. Never filter by the `cwd` recorded inside transcripts: it goes stale after `agx sessions promote` / `sessions move` (bug fixed 2026-09-24 in 55979e7, guarded by TestPromoteThenResume and TestConversations_AfterMove). Code: provider/claude/conversations.go.
